bounded_findings: Affirmative commands use irrealis forms without person-number agreement; transitive and intransitive formations differ. A dictionary root is not automatically the correct UI imperative.
Negative commands have distinct constructions; app failure statements must not be fabricated by mechanically negating a menu command.
Sequential commands can require different morphology across coordinated clauses; multi-action recovery instructions need full-clause review rather than concatenated glossary entries.
effect: Supports grammatical review of future ch proposals, not technical vocabulary, dialect/orthography selection, independent wording acceptance or new production edits. Chamorro ch remains distinct from paused Cherokee chr.
